page_title: BRE 1-4 WOL | Brentford v Wolves 27/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+5' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
90+4' Matt Doherty (Wolves) touches the ball with his hand. Brentford have a free kick.
90+3' The attendance for today's match is 17109.
90+2' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Michael Olakigbe (Brentford) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar.
90+2' Thomas Doyle (Wolves) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
90+1' Andy Madley interrupts the game. One of the players from Brentford won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
90' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) misses a great chance after striking the ball towards the left side of the goal and the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
89' One of the Brentford players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
88' A pass into the penalty area from Neal Maupay (Brentford) is intercepted by the defence.
86' Here is a change. Keane Lewis-Potter is going off and Thomas Frank gives the last tactical orders to Myles Peart-Harris (Brentford).
86' Substitution. Michael Olakigbe (Brentford) in, Yoane Wissa out.
84' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
83' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
82' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
80' The referee signals a substitution. Hugo Bueno (Wolves) is brought on as a substitute for Rayan Ait Nouri.

79' 1 - 4 Goal! Great play by Matheus Cunha releases Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into bottom left corner. 1:4.
79' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
78' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) attempts to set up his teammate with a scoring opportunity by chipping in a fine pass from the edge of the box, but one of the defenders intercepts his effort.
76' Matheus Cunha (Wolves) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort came back off the right post!
74' Andy Madley blows his whistle. Mathias Jensen (Brentford) commits a foul after dangerous play.
73' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
72' A raking crossfield pass from Mathias Jensen (Brentford) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession.

70' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
69' The possession of the ball – 56:44.
68' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
67' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Mads Roerslev Rasmussen as he is replaced by Mathias Jensen (Brentford).

67' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
67' A pass by Matheus Cunha (Wolves) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
65' Substitution. Thomas Doyle (Wolves) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Pablo Sarabia walks off.
64' Gary O'Neil prepares a substitution. Nelson Semedo is replaced by Matt Doherty (Wolves).
64' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
63' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) is caught offside by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
62' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Wolves.
61' Corner kicks – 6:2.
59' The game is interrupted. Nelson Semedo (Wolves) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
59' Brentford hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
57' Mark Flekken (Brentford) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
56' Neal Maupay (Brentford) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
55' Brentford are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
54' Max Kilman (Wolves) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
53' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) has time on the edge of the box. His shot is disappointing, though, as it flies towards the middle of the goal where Jose Sa makes a comfortable save.
53' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
52' Brentford players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
51' Brentford have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
51' Neal Maupay (Brentford) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. Now Brentford have a corner.
50' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Wolves, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
49' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Brentford, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
48' Joao Gomes (Wolves) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. There is a free kick near the sideline to Brentford.
47' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) controls a reverse pass deep inside the box and smacks the ball low towards the middle of the goal, but the Jose Sa anticipates well and smothers the ball.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Thomas Frank gives a chance to Mikkel Damsgaard and Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) is off.
46' Andy Madley blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+9' The end of the first half.
45+8' Neal Maupay (Brentford) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from the edge of the box, but it goes just wide of the left post.
45+7' Gary O'Neil is forced to make a change. Hee-Chan Hwang is unable to continue due to injury, Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) comes on.
45+4' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
45+4' Saman Ghoddos (Brentford) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
45+2' The corner is swung in but Wolves can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

45+2' Neal Maupay (Brentford) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Jose Sa pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
45+1' A spell of possession for Brentford in an attempt to control the game.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
45' Mario Lemina (Wolves) was too forceful with his tackle and Andy Madley interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
43' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
43' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
40' Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford) connects well with the free kick, but heads the ball just over the bar from close in. The ball goes out of play and Wolves will have a goal kick.
40' Toti (Wolves) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. Brentford will take a free kick.
40' A long pass, executed by Jose Sa (Wolves), missed the precision to reach his teammates.
39' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) is penalised for a foul. Andy Madley had a clear view and blows his whistle.
38' A player from Wolves commits a rough challenge. Andy Madley blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
37' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
36' Brentford take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
36' The cross into the penalty area from Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
33' Rayan Ait Nouri (Wolves) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play. Wolves will take a throw-in.
33' The resulting free kick from Saman Ghoddos (Brentford) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
32' Joao Gomes (Wolves) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Andy Madley has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
30' Wolves are seeing far more of the ball now.

28' 1 - 3 Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Mark Flekken is just a bystander as the ball flies into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:3.
28' That was close. Mario Lemina (Wolves) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
27' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
26' The Brentford players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
25' A cross by Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
24' A quickly taken corner by Brentford.
24' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
22' The shots on goal statistics – 2:2.
21' Brentford keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
19' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
18' Neal Maupay (Brentford) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Jose Sa, who pulls off a comfortable save!
16' 1 - 2 Goal! Neal Maupay displays great vision and sends a pass to Yoane Wissa (Brentford), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the top of the net. The score is 1:2.

14' 0 - 2 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 0:2.
13' 0 - 1 Mario Lemina (Wolves) leaps to meet an excellent cross and steers a fantastic header past the goalkeeper, inside the right post.
13' Wolves force a corner. They send men into the box.
11' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
9' Nelson Semedo (Wolves) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
8' Max Kilman (Wolves) passes the ball and slows down the tempo so his team can continue with their combination play.
8' Brentford failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
7' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brentford comes to nothing. Brentford force their opponents to concede a corner.

6' Saman Ghoddos (Brentford) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The linesman points to the corner flag, Brentford are going to take it.
5' Mario Lemina (Wolves) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
4' Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
3' Brentford work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
2' The Wolves players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Brentford will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Andy Madley.
